formal88_role: Model choice informed by prior benchmark; routing effectiveness is not claimed until Hybrid-Test.

global.rule_positive: accept when detector has localized/structural evidence, except figure readability which also needs VLM importance confirmation
global.rule_abstain: send to assigned VLM; preserve abstention if VLM lacks localized evidence
global.rule_negative: suppress same-label VLM allegation only for active high-coverage source rule; otherwise retain review path
global.not_applicable: VLM or human review; never map to none
